imageConstraints: Use the same 30 × 20 × 13 cm expanded basin in every scene, together with the real front/top camera references and the approved current tube reference.
Keep a moderately rectangular rounded 3:2 footprint. Screen pixel ratios vary with camera perspective; do not stretch one image axis to force a 3:2 screen bounding box.
Show a compact facial basin at believable scale against hands, head and counter. Avoid foreground perspective that makes it look like a large tub.
Keep both long-side handles, short-rim dips, two white folding bands, integrated blue base/grid and the permanently attached current twin tube with blue mouthpiece.
When collapsed, preserve footprint and mold; collapsed height has not been supplied. Do not infer capacity or new measurements from the expanded bounding box.
